name: smith one leg floor calf raise
description: A one-leg calf raise lifting a smith machine bar from the floor. It works each calf on its own under a guided bar path.
instructions: Set the smith bar at shoulder height and step under it so it rests across your upper back.
Unrack it and stand on one foot, bending the other leg behind you.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your standing foot.
Pause, then lower your heel back to the floor.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
